name: Kurobuchi Kasumi
source:
Objective and motives unknown. A Sky Walker that stands out a lot thanks to her own violent behavior. Doesn't it look like she is looking for someone with those keen eyes of hers?

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
目的和动机不明。她是个因暴力行为而格外显眼的Sky Walker。她那锐利的目光，难道不像是在寻找某个人吗？

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
